```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(phyloseq)
library(microbiomeMarker)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(openxlsx)
library(here)

run_name   <- params$run_name
output_dir <- params$output_dir
lda_cutoff <- params$lda_cutoff
pval_cutoff <- params$pval_cutoff
prefix     <- paste0(run_name, "_")

dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## 1. Load Data and Build Phyloseq Object

```{r load-data}
# Relative abundance (rows: species, columns: samples)
otu_data <- read_excel(here("data", "species_abundance.xlsx"),
                       sheet = "species_relabund")
otu_matrix <- as.matrix(otu_data[, -1])
rownames(otu_matrix) <- otu_data[[1]]

# Metadata
metadata <- read_excel(here("data", "metadata.xlsx"), sheet = "metadata")
metadata <- as.data.frame(metadata)
rownames(metadata) <- metadata$SampleID

# Align samples
common_samples <- intersect(colnames(otu_matrix), rownames(metadata))
otu_clean      <- otu_matrix[, common_samples]
meta_clean     <- metadata[common_samples, ]
meta_clean$Enterotype <- as.factor(meta_clean$Enterotype)

cat("Samples:", ncol(otu_clean), "\n")
cat("Species:", nrow(otu_clean), "\n")
cat("Enterotype distribution:\n")
print(table(meta_clean$Enterotype))

# Build phyloseq
ps <- phyloseq(
  otu_table(otu_clean, taxa_are_rows = TRUE),
  sample_data(meta_clean)
)

# Filter: prevalence >= 10%, mean abundance >= 0.01%
ps_filtered <- filter_taxa(ps, function(x) {
  sum(x > 0) / length(x) >= 0.10 & mean(x) >= 0.0001
}, TRUE)

cat("\nAfter filtering:", ntaxa(ps_filtered), "species retained\n")
```

## 2. LEfSe Analysis

```{r lefse, warning=FALSE}
# Clean taxa names (remove special characters that break LEfSe internals)
ps_lefse <- ps_filtered
original_names <- taxa_names(ps_lefse)
cleaned_names  <- gsub("[|\\[\\]\\.\\-:]", "_", original_names)
taxa_names(ps_lefse) <- cleaned_names

# Add minimal taxonomy table required by microbiomeMarker
tax_mat <- matrix(taxa_names(ps_lefse), nrow = ntaxa(ps_lefse), ncol = 1)
rownames(tax_mat) <- taxa_names(ps_lefse)
colnames(tax_mat) <- "Species"
tax_table(ps_lefse) <- tax_table(tax_mat)

sample_data(ps_lefse)$Enterotype <- droplevels(sample_data(ps_lefse)$Enterotype)

cat("Running LEfSe...\n")
lefse_result <- run_lefse(
  ps_lefse,
  group         = "Enterotype",
  taxa_rank     = "Species",
  wilcoxon_cutoff = pval_cutoff,
  lda_cutoff    = lda_cutoff,
  norm          = "CPM"
)

# Extract marker table
marker_tbl <- marker_table(lefse_result)

# Add FDR correction (manual, FDR method)
marker_tbl$p_adjust <- p.adjust(marker_tbl$pvalue, method = "fdr")

# Restore original taxa names
name_map <- setNames(original_names, cleaned_names)
marker_tbl$feature <- name_map[marker_tbl$feature]

cat("Biomarkers identified:", nrow(marker_tbl), "\n")
print(marker_tbl)
```

## 3. Export Results

```{r export}
# Split by enterotype
results_list <- list(All_Markers = as.data.frame(marker_tbl))

for (grp in unique(marker_tbl$enrich_group)) {
  results_list[[paste0("Markers_", grp)]] <- marker_tbl %>%
    filter(enrich_group == grp) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(ef_lda))) %>%
    as.data.frame()
}

# Summary stats per group
results_list[["Summary"]] <- marker_tbl %>%
  group_by(enrich_group) %>%
  summarise(N_markers   = n(),
            Mean_LDA    = mean(abs(ef_lda)),
            Median_LDA  = median(abs(ef_lda)),
            Max_LDA     = max(abs(ef_lda)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  as.data.frame()

write.xlsx(results_list,
           file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "LEfSe_results.xlsx")))

cat("Results exported.\n")
```

## 4. Visualizations

```{r plot-bar, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
# Standard LEfSe bar plot
tryCatch({
  p_bar <- plot_ef_bar(lefse_result)
  print(p_bar)
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "LEfSe_barplot.png")),
         p_bar, width = 10, height = max(6, nrow(marker_tbl) * 0.25), dpi = 300)
}, error = function(e) cat("plot_ef_bar failed:", e$message, "\n"))
```
